actions.name: teable_create_record
actions.description: Creates a new record in a Teable table.

actions.name: teable_create_records
actions.description: Creates multiple records in a Teable table in one call.

actions.name: teable_list_records
actions.description: Retrieves records from a table with optional filtering, search, and sorting, paging through results automatically.

actions.name: teable_get_record
actions.description: Retrieves a single record from a table by its ID.

actions.name: teable_update_record
actions.description: Updates an existing record in a Teable table.

actions.name: teable_update_records
actions.description: Updates multiple records in a Teable table in one call.

actions.name: teable_delete_record
actions.description: Deletes a record from a Teable table by its ID.

actions.name: teable_delete_records
actions.description: Permanently deletes multiple records from a Teable table by their IDs.

actions.name: teable_upload_attachment
actions.description: Uploads a file as an attachment to a field in a Teable record.

actions.name: teable_list_bases
actions.description: Lists all bases the connection has access to.

actions.name: teable_list_tables
actions.description: Lists all tables in a base.

actions.name: teable_list_fields
actions.description: Lists all fields of a table.

actions.name: teable_list_views
actions.description: Lists all views of a table.

actions.name: teable_create_table
actions.description: Creates a new table in a base.

actions.name: teable_create_field
actions.description: Adds a new field (column) to a table.

actions.name: teable_add_comment
actions.description: Adds a comment to a record.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: teable_new_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a new record is created in a table.

triggers.name: teable_updated_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is created or modified. The table must have a "Last modified time" field that shows the time.
